value.rationale: Both optimal adversarial game numbers and all optimal replies are determined on a natural cubic planar vertex-transitive graph, with a full five-shell geographic rule explaining why starting as minimizer costs one additional move. Unlike a mere numeric optimum or arbitrary slice, the complete strategic classification links game score to antipodal/distance-three geometry and quantifies the gap from six static dominating vertices to eight/nine game moves.
